roadmap_90_day: Wk1: Healthcare Administration Careers pillar - salary, paths, getting hired (BLS $117,960 median, 23.2% growth, 62,100 openings/yr; hub for all clusters)
Wk2: Healthcare Administration Salary Guide 2026-27 with state + entry-level vs master's breakouts (featured-snippet target)
Wk2: Healthcare Administrator Job Titles: 12 roles & what each pays (role hub linking to every future role page)
Wk3: MHA vs MBA in Healthcare: which degree pays off (~300-600/mo money question)
Wk3: Healthcare Administration vs Healthcare Management vs Public Health (merge the comparison intents on one page)
Wk4: FACHE Certification: requirements, exam & ROI 2026 (enrollment-exam CTAs; prep-product seed)
Wk4: CPHQ Certification Guide: is it worth it, cost & salary
Wk5: New-Grad Hub: healthcare admin jobs with no experience - 7 entry doors (newsletter capture)
Wk5: Healthcare Administration Resume with No Experience (template + sample) - lead-magnet gateway (Resume Playbook)
Wk6: Healthcare Administration Interview Questions & Answers (bank + model answers; AI Interview Coach gateway)
Wk6: CPPS Certification: guide, cost & study plan (fastest rank - near-zero competition)
Wk7: Best Healthcare Administration Certifications ranked by career stage (commercial listicle; links to FACHE/CPHQ/CPPS pages)

Wk7-8: How to Become a Healthcare Administrator step-by-step, no MBA required (BA/BS holders) + Practice Manager & Revenue Cycle Manager career ladders (mid-career Career Navigator audience; series start)
Wk8-9: Healthcare Project Manager: do you need a PMP? (long 'without pmp' tail)

Wk9-12: Role salary deep-dives (Nursing Home Administrator + Clinical Operations Manager + Patient Access Manager), then refresh salary pillar with fresh BLS/state data; every post links up to a hub and down to a product page so clusters compound authority
technical_seo: Schema: Person (Dr. Ashley w/ alumniOf, hasOccupation lecturer, sameAs YouTube @professorashley + LinkedIn for EEAT), Organization + WebSite + SearchAction, BlogPosting/Article with author + dateModified on every post, FAQPage ONLY where Q&A is genuinely on-page (monetized/off-page Q&A risks manual action), Course/Product+Offer ($29/mo, $19-49) for the AI tools, BreadcrumbList, HowTo on the resume-template page, VideoObject where posts embed her YouTube videos

Structure: flat URLs (/blog/<slug>/, /navigator/, /coach/ as server-rendered crawlable pages - no JS-only shells), category archives for salary/certifications/careers, product pages reachable in <=2 clicks from any article, self-canonicals, XML sitemap + RSS
Internal linking: every role/cert page links to exactly one hub (pillar-spoke), 2-4 contextual links per article, natural exact-match anchors, end-of-article 'next step' block to product/lead magnet

Core Web Vitals targets: LCP < 2.5s, INP < 200ms, CLS < 0.1; keep the static pre-rendered stack (no heavy SPA), preload hero font, width/height + lazy-load images, AVIF/WebP, Brotli + HTTP caching, minimal third-party scripts on articles

On-page: mobile-first (Lighthouse), descriptive titles <=60 chars, meta description containing the number/answer for CTR, question-form H2s for PAA/featured-snippet capture, data tables for salary/state pages, >=1,000 words on money pages, YouTube embeds for dwell time
youtube_to_site_tactics: Pin a comment + end-screen on every upload pointing to one mapped landing page ('salary guide + free resume playbook -> thehcadaily.com'), plus a weekly community-tab teaser with the site link

Every video description routes to exactly one gated asset (HCA Resume Playbook or Ambulatory KPI/MGMA cheat sheet) via a /free/ page with the email form wired to the already-built 5-part onboarding sequence - no description CTA goes to a dead end

Publish a text twin of every video within 7 days (transcript republished as a unique post + data table + YouTube embed), so Google surfaces her videos in carousels AND the site ranks for spoken-transcript long-tail
Structure descriptions like a mini-SERP: 3-line 'what this video answers' summary then the link, to lift click-through on both YouTube SEO and the site visit
Run 2x/month 15-30s direct-response videos ('what a healthcare admin actually earns - full breakdown + free checklist on my site') as the standing conversion format
Map her strongest topics (degree decisions, certs, resumes) to a 5-day email course; video CTA = 'get the email course', which delivers site articles and the product pitch by day 5

Mine the comment stream weekly - every recurring 'how do I become X / is Y worth it' comment becomes next week's blog post, and Search Console video-impression data picks which site pages become the next video
Keep @professorashley name, avatar and topic consistent across YouTube, the site's author box and LinkedIn so Google builds one trusted entity ('Professor Ashley') that lifts EEAT on all site pages
